methods.trigger: Create or revise an actual reusable skill
methods.outcome: Inspect its existing owner, instructions, references and distribution; verify changed behavior
methods.boundary: No new skill when a reference or existing skill suffices

methods.trigger: Authorized work needs sustained independent progress
methods.outcome: Bounded units, resource/budget checks, proof and recovery
methods.boundary: Autonomy does not expand authority

methods.trigger: A coherent authorized end-to-end delivery task
methods.outcome: Use the Integrated Workflow lifecycle and applicable quality/review gates
methods.boundary: No bypass of current delivery boundary

methods.trigger: Work crosses a real stack or dependent set of changes
methods.outcome: Preserve dependency order and integrated acceptance
methods.boundary: No second coordinator or unconditional whole-stack rewrite

methods.trigger: An already authorized asynchronous job or PR needs monitoring
methods.outcome: Observe the actual job, bounded polling, reconcile failures
methods.boundary: No unrelated new run, review trigger or indefinite loop

methods.trigger: A reproducible or well-evidenced defect
methods.outcome: Triage, causal fix and meaningful regression evidence
methods.boundary: Do not relabel unrelated hardening as the reported defect

methods.trigger: A material choice requires comparative evidence
methods.outcome: Comparable tasks, baseline/candidate identity, positive and negative cases
methods.boundary: No invented benchmark, arbitrary threshold or evaluation of every trivial edit

methods.trigger: An approved new behavior is being implemented
methods.outcome: User-visible acceptance, dependencies and focused checks
methods.boundary: Preserve scope; no speculative adjacent features

methods.trigger: A defined outcome can improve through useful measured iterations
methods.outcome: A valid baseline, bounded experiments and retained best evidence
methods.boundary: No optimizing a proxy while correctness or authority regresses

methods.trigger: The task asks for understanding or diagnosis before a change
methods.outcome: Relevant source/evidence, hypotheses and explicit uncertainty
methods.boundary: Do not implement under a read-only investigation scope

methods.trigger: Substantial work needs ordered coherent phases
methods.outcome: Reuse create-plan and accepted IDs with dependencies and evidence
methods.boundary: No competing programme or replanning approved work by default

methods.trigger: The authorized slice is ready for a PR
methods.outcome: Clean intentional diff, current evidence, correct base/head and review-ready description
methods.boundary: PR creation does not certify required review or merge

methods.trigger: Distinct dependent or specialist work warrants coordination
methods.outcome: One workflow-orchestrator, bounded roles, shared authority and one acceptance owner
methods.boundary: No mandatory delegation when one agent is sufficient

methods.trigger: A stop, limitation or interruption requires a durable handoff
methods.outcome: Preserve state, side effects, evidence and exact next action
methods.boundary: No cancellation claim without observing actual job state

methods.trigger: A measured performance problem needs diagnosis
methods.outcome: Relevant baseline, bottleneck evidence and outcome check
methods.boundary: No unmeasured tuning or behavior regression for speed

methods.trigger: A bounded uncertain idea needs a useful disposable experiment
methods.outcome: State what question the prototype resolves and its limitations
methods.boundary: No prototype presented as production-ready proof

methods.trigger: Internal structure needs change with intended behavior preserved
methods.outcome: Consumer scope, behavior evidence and compatible migration
methods.boundary: No unintended public behavior change

methods.trigger: Live/runtime behavior needs permitted investigation
methods.outcome: Actual environment identity, observed evidence and data minimization
methods.boundary: No unauthorized production access or copied secrets

methods.trigger: Resume after interruption, handoff or context loss
methods.outcome: Recover current contract and refresh changed/volatile evidence
methods.boundary: Old trails do not override current code, grants or task state

methods.trigger: The authorized candidate is ready for its selected delivery target
methods.outcome: Applicable reviews/checks, exact target and observed final result
methods.boundary: Local completion does not imply publication, release or deployment

methods.trigger: A trace or event sequence can explain the problem
methods.outcome: Source identity, causal sequence and supported conclusions
methods.boundary: No transcript hoarding or invented runtime observations

methods.trigger: A requested visual reference must be matched
methods.outcome: Relevant rendered views and dimensions with observable comparison
methods.boundary: No pixel-parity demand for unrelated content work

methods.trigger: Task-owned worktrees or branches can be safely retired
methods.outcome: Verify ownership, unmerged work, active jobs and intended destination
methods.boundary: Never discard unrelated user work or treat a branch name as sufficient proof
